questions.Q9.0: On fresh seeds, in how many of the eight analysis cells does released QDF (QDF_LR1) still pass the original analysis-cell rule (g_QDF_LR1 > 0 in 3/3 seeds and mean g_QDF_LR1 >= max(0.005, 3 nu))? Reported as a count; no cell is added or removed.
questions.Q9.1: Q8.1 on fresh seeds: does the validated surrogate I + a*S0n recover >= 80% of validated QDF's gain?
questions.Q9.2: Q8.2 on fresh seeds: does I + a*D0n beat I + a*S0n?
questions.Q9.3: Q8.3 on fresh seeds: does the replay recover the gain, (i) REPLAY_K1 with no validation, (ii) REPLAY_VAL?
questions.XM: Cross-machine check: do SIGMA_I and QDF_LR1 at seed 2021 in the eight cells reproduce the v8 test MSE of machine 704 on machine 697?

decision_rules.Q9.0: report the count n9 and the list; Q9.1-Q9.3 are evaluated on all eight cells regardless of n9 (the cells were fixed before v9), and additionally reported descriptively on the n9 passing cells

Q9.1.SURROGATE_MATCHES_TUNED_QDF: in >= k cells R_PLUGIN_VAL >= 0.8 and g_PLUGIN_VAL > 0 for 3/3 seeds

Q9.2.DIAG_BETTER: in >= k cells mean D_diag > 0 and D_diag > 0 for 3/3 seeds
Q9.2.DIAG_WORSE: in >= k cells mean D_diag < 0 and D_diag < 0 for 3/3 seeds

Q9.3.REPLAY_RECOVERS: in >= k cells R_REPLAY_K1 >= 0.8 and g_REPLAY_K1 > 0 for 3/3 seeds (same rule reported for REPLAY_VAL)

decision_rules.XM: IDENTICAL if all 16 test MSEs equal the v8 values exactly; otherwise report max relative difference. v9 numbers are never mixed with v8 numbers within a cell in either case.
decision_rules.secondary: Wilcoxon signed-rank over cells of mean(g_PLUGIN_VAL - g_QDF_VAL), mean(g_REPLAY_K1 - g_QDF_VAL), mean(g_PDIAG_VAL - g_QDF_VAL); per-cell t-intervals; selected m and a; per-cell comparison with v8 (descriptive).
